tasks.title: Create the static structural scaffold
acceptanceCriteria: Semantic landmarks and responsive navigation exist.
The page renders a useful no-JavaScript baseline.
JavaScript loads content.json with a safe fallback.
The systems map is keyboard operable.
Validation checks required files, JSON shape, internal anchors, and unsafe remote references.

tasks.title: Establish content schema and visual foundation
acceptanceCriteria: content.json defines navigation, hero, modules, timeline, principles, and calls to action.
Copy is public-safe, conceptual, and explicitly noncanonical.
CSS provides responsive layout, visible focus, practical contrast, and reduced-motion behavior.
No external fonts, trackers, stock assets, or remote runtime dependencies are introduced.

integrationNotes: Build and Experience paths are intentionally disjoint for the first cycle.
Integrate may merge one passing PR from each implementation lane per firing.
